summary: Narrow bush-edged lane with no room off the road; homes close further on.
reasons: Narrow lane, bush bank, no pull-off

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace north edge at the wooded start, above the hairpin

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north side; nearest houses 20-22m across the road. Beyond 21m apartments and houses sit 5-9m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane runs tight between wooded bank and the road edge, with no verge or pull-in visible; no cars parked here.
drivers.traffic: Through street with buses; the end meets a busy road at a junction.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars on this stretch, so no overnight convention.

flags: Steep: 6.8% mean, 16% max; about 9% at best section
sun_shade: Dense bush canopy over the north side; shade from the north and east.
